svg.text: Expand-on-signal metric collection for Kubernetes. Wide and cheap by default. When an alert fires,
zoom in DOWN the metric tree and OUT the dependency graph. When it clears, zoom back out.

g.text: Every metric, every node, every scrape.
Pays in CPU, storage and ingest, and the
monitoring stack becomes the noisy neighbour.
Sampling helps traces only. Drop rules, caps
and rollups are fixed in advance. eBPF tools
wait for a human. Blind when incidents start.
Zoom-Lens: a control loop for telemetry
Roots only in steady state. An alert expands
collection DOWN + OUT, deeper the longer it
fires. It reverts automatically when it clears.

svg.text: One alert → scoped collection decision → existing CNCF actuators → automatic revert
DaemonSet · one per node · own OpAMP identity
L0 base config: roots only · 30s · minimal host scrapers
scrapes only its own node's targets
each with its own OpAMP identity.
from L2, via the K8s API
Two graphs, one alert, one expansion.

g.text: 1 hop at L1 → 2 hops at L3

svg.text: Every related entity gets its roots + depth-1 children.
Incident jobs carry children only, so roots are never duplicated.
The longer it fires, the deeper, wider and faster it collects.
Built on what you already run
Vendor-neutral · open source · no new agents
Wide and cheap by default. Deep exactly where and when it matters.
